name: lumbar
title: Lumbar
description: A laminated spine-chart theme for an osteopath or chiropractor: on white with black print, every kind of care is one outlined vertebra in a stacked column with blue discs between and a red number on each bone, its name out on a leader to the left and its description to the right.

tokens.--font-body: running text, descriptions, hours, footer (humanist sans)
tokens.--font-label: the chart's printed labels in capitals: site name, menu, headings, care names, buttons, vertebra numbers, masthead phones (condensed sans)
tokens.--text-s: labels, dates, the emergency note, table headings, footer notes, care descriptions on phones
tokens.--text-m: body text, menu, buttons, vertebra numbers
tokens.--text-l: care names on the chart, ledes, masthead phones, box headings
tokens.--tracking: letter spacing of the condensed capitals
tokens.--color-bg: laminate-white page background; text on the Book button
tokens.--color-text: print-black ink: text, links, outlines of bones and boxes, rules, the Book button, focus rings
tokens.--color-muted: labels, ledes, dates, plain-list descriptions, footer notes
tokens.--color-accent: arterial red: the two rules round the masthead's emergency label
tokens.--color-number: arterial red of the number on each vertebra (dark enough to read on bone)
tokens.--color-bone: bone ivory: vertebrae, sacrum, bone bands of the mark by the site name
tokens.--color-disc: disc blue: pads between vertebrae, disc bands of the mark by the site name
tokens.--color-leader: leader lines joining care names and descriptions to their vertebra
tokens.--color-line: hairlines: table, hours and plain-list rows, step dividers, the rule above the menu, menu hover
tokens.--color-panel: the appointment box, code backgrounds, button hover
tokens.--spine-col: width of the chart's spine column (scaled down on phones)
tokens.--bone-l: width of vertebra 7 onwards and of the sacrum
tokens.--wing: reach of the side processes past the largest vertebrae
tokens.--disc: thickness of an ordinary disc pad
tokens.--disc-wide: thickness of the pads after vertebrae 3 and 6
tokens.--rule: outlines of bones, boxes and buttons; section rules; the emergency rules
tokens.--rule-heavy: heavy chart border atop masthead, footer and appointment box
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of buttons, boxes and step numbers
tokens.--radius-bone: corner rounding of each vertebra and the top of the sacrum
tokens.--tap: minimum height of menu items, buttons and page links
